text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 29, 2024) for 2645 Bloor Street West.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 29, 2024) for 2645 Bloor Street West, Folder Number 24 204487 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to May 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
